sources.title: A light-weight and efficient punctuation and word casing prediction ...
sources.snippet: Due to the deep model depth of Transformer, the size of Transformer based models is usually very large, which impedes their deployment on edge devices. In summary, our contributions are the following: 1) We propose a CNN-BiLSTM model to jointly predict punctuation and word casing only based on lexical features.
